name: Cosy Room, Lisbon
description: Eighteen square metres on the second and third floors of the old shipping office, with a tall sash window onto Rua da Boavista and the original pine floorboards sanded back and oiled. A queen bed in Portuguese linen, a small writing desk, a rain shower lined in hand-glazed white tile. Quiet, simple and all you need for a city stay.
details: 18 m², floors 2 and 3
Queen bed, 160 cm, Portuguese cotton percale
Rain shower, hand-glazed tile, Claus Porto soap
Writing desk, Roberts radio, no television
Street-facing with secondary glazing
Breakfast at Maré included
imageQuery: small hotel room white linen bed wooden floor window

name: Classic Room, Lisbon
description: Twenty-six square metres with two tall windows, a king bed dressed in undyed linen and a reading chair by Branca Lisboa in oak and leather. The bathroom keeps the building's 1920s marble and adds a deep soaking tub. Rooms on the fourth floor catch the afternoon light off the Tagus.
details: 26 m², floors 2 to 4
King bed, 180 cm, undyed Portuguese linen
Soaking tub and separate rain shower, original marble
Branca Lisboa oak reading chair
Minibar stocked with Portuguese wine and tinned fish
Breakfast at Maré included
imageQuery: hotel room bathtub marble bathroom elegant light

name: River Terrace Room, Lisbon
description: On the top floor, with a private terrace of about twelve square metres looking south over the rooftops of Santos to the river and the 25 de Abril bridge. Inside, a king bed, a limestone bathroom and a pair of linen armchairs angled at the view. Coffee on the terrace at 8 a.m. is the reason people rebook.
details: 32 m² plus 12 m² private terrace, floor 5
King bed, 180 cm, undyed Portuguese linen
Limestone bathroom, rain shower, double basin
Terrace with two chairs, table and a lemon tree
River and bridge view
Breakfast at Maré included
imageQuery: rooftop terrace lisbon river view chairs morning

name: Boavista Suite, Lisbon
description: The former director's office, fifty-eight square metres across a corner of the fourth floor with five windows and the building's original coffered ceiling. A separate sitting room with a long sofa and a record player, a king bedroom, and a bathroom with a freestanding tub set under the window. Takes a cot or a sofa bed for a child.
details: 58 m², corner of floor 4, two rooms
King bed, 180 cm, undyed Portuguese linen
Sitting room with sofa bed, record player and a small library
Freestanding tub under the window, separate shower
Original coffered ceiling, five sash windows
Breakfast at Maré and a welcome bottle of Bairrada sparkling included

name: Cosy Room, Copenhagen
description: Nineteen square metres in the warehouse's original timber frame, with one big window onto the courtyard, exposed Douglas fir beams and a queen bed in grey Danish linen. A compact bathroom with a heated concrete floor. Rooms are dark in the best Copenhagen way: thick walls, heavy curtains, very good sleep.
details: 19 m², courtyard side, floors 1 to 3
Queen bed, 160 cm, Danish linen
Walk-in shower, heated concrete floor
Exposed Douglas fir beams
Frama toiletries
Breakfast at Kaj included
imageQuery: scandinavian hotel room wooden beams grey linen bed

name: Classic Room, Copenhagen
description: Twenty-seven square metres on the street side, with two warehouse windows, a king bed and a daybed under the window for reading. Furniture is Danish and mostly second-hand: a Børge Mogensen chair, a Le Klint lamp, a wool rug from a mill in Jutland. The bathroom pairs smoked oak with pale green tile.
details: 27 m², street side, floors 1 to 4
King bed, 180 cm, Danish linen
Daybed under the window
Rain shower, smoked oak and green tile
Vintage Danish furniture, Le Klint lighting
Breakfast at Kaj included
imageQuery: danish design hotel room chair lamp window light

name: Harbour Room, Copenhagen
description: Thirty-three square metres on the harbour side of the top two floors, with a window seat the width of the room looking across the water to the Opera House. King bed, a small kitchen counter with a kettle and good cups, and a bathroom with a tub. In summer you can watch the harbour swimmers from bed.
details: 33 m², harbour side, floors 4 and 5
King bed, 180 cm, Danish linen
Full-width window seat with harbour and Opera House view
Bathtub and separate shower
Kitchen counter with kettle, Hasle Bornholm ceramics
Breakfast at Kaj included
imageQuery: hotel bedroom large window water view minimalist white

name: Toldbod Suite, Copenhagen
description: The gable end of the warehouse, sixty-two square metres under a double-height roof with the original hoist beam still in place. A sitting room with a wood-burning stove and a dining table for six, a mezzanine king bedroom and a bathroom in dark green marble. Harbour views from every window.
details: 62 m², gable end, floors 4 and 5 with mezzanine
King bed, 180 cm, on the mezzanine
Sitting room with wood-burning stove, dining table for six
Dark green marble bathroom, tub and shower
Harbour views on two sides
Breakfast at Kaj and a private harbour sauna slot included

name: Cosy Room, Barcelona
description: Seventeen square metres on the inner patio of the townhouse, cool and silent even in August. Catalan vaulted ceiling, hydraulic mosaic floor tiles reclaimed from the building, a queen bed and a small shower room in terrazzo. The patio below has a fig tree and the sound of the fountain.
details: 17 m², patio side, floors 1 to 3
Queen bed, 160 cm, Spanish cotton percale
Terrazzo shower room
Original hydraulic mosaic floor, vaulted ceiling
Air conditioning, ceiling fan
Breakfast at Terrat included
imageQuery: small hotel bedroom white walls patterned tile floor bed mediterranean

name: Classic Room, Barcelona
description: Twenty-five square metres with a balcony onto Carrer de la Mercè, tall shuttered doors and a king bed under a restored painted ceiling. Furniture is Catalan: a rattan Expormim chair, a cork side table, a Santa & Cole lamp. The bathroom is lined in green glazed Valencian tile with a rain shower.

King bed, 180 cm, Spanish cotton percale
Rain shower, green Valencian tile
Juliet balcony with shutters
Restored painted ceiling

name: Rooftop Room, Barcelona
description: One of six rooms on the roof, each opening onto its own section of terrace with a daybed and a view over the Gothic Quarter to the sea. Thirty square metres inside with a king bed, a bath by the window and plenty of cross-breeze. Two floors up is the pool and the restaurant; you will not need shoes.
details: 30 m² plus 10 m² private terrace, floor 5
King bed, 180 cm, Spanish cotton percale
Bath by the window, separate shower
Private terrace with daybed, sea and old-town view
Direct stair to the pool and Terrat

A separate sitting room with a dining table, a king bedroom and a bathroom in pink Alicante marble with a double shower. Sleeps a family of four with the sofa bed.
